_comment: Corrections to scripts/i18n_glossary.py's results, checked by hand on the language wikis. They replace what the script finds. Say where each was checked.

Wallet.note: The English wiki's Wallet redirects to Currency, so its links name currency. Each of these is the wallet's own page on its wiki.

Wardrobe.note: The English page links to the German Account-Tresor (account vault). The German wiki's wardrobe pages are Garderobe/...

Guild Vault.note: Coffre de guilde: page on the French wiki. No German page found.
